analysis:
This PR contains only documentation and a changelog: changelog.d/selected-models-recover.md (new), docs/architecture/addon-hold.md (lines 65-68 head) and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md (new section at head lines 371-408). No executable code is in the supplied units, so no control regression can be shown from this evidence. The docs describe a new provider behavior, selected-model recovery (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift, not supplied). It retries selected models with backoff, may evict non-selected idle models before loading (allowEviction false for the load itself), and cancels a load when an add-on hold begins.

Security-relevant claims for the next review to verify against the source, none of which is proven here:
1. TB-012/T-059/A-018: the add-on hold must still gate recovery loads. The docs say recovery is refused while held and that enterAddonHold cancels a recovery load already in flight. If the code lacks this, models could load beside VMs.
2. Recovery evictions bypass the usual load path (victims are evicted before the load's own checks). The docs say eviction respects evictionExclusions, Autopilot holds, pins, leases, min_dwell and idle thresholds, and that a failed load costs at most one attempt's evictions. A local same-UID process cannot trigger this except through hold or lease state, but the claim should be verified.
3. The changelog notes a policy 'pending owner review' that releases adopted non-selected models after 10 minutes. It is described as policy and is not shown to be implemented here. Its availability effect (A-018, T-029) needs review if the code ships.
4. The change to shutdown (a 15 s bound per unload) and the drain-with-coordinator-down behavior affect TB-002 availability and T-010. Verify they do not leave decrypted prompt or KV data (A-001, T-028) resident longer than before, or skip KV release on a timed-out unload.
5. The unload-only Autopilot path queues nothing. Confirm that a hold's unload keeps loaded-models.json (invariant 6).

No prefix-cache (T-041), attestation or key-handling changes are visible. Nothing in the supplied units shows a new threat or an invalidated assumption, so there are no findings. needs_deeper_review is true only because the implementing Swift source is unsupplied.
